subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Learning Club 2 – Lesson 2: CLIL Social Studies (In my town)
outcomes: I can name places in a town: school, hospital, shops, houses, café.
I can describe my town with There is a … / There are some …
I can use words and sentences from Units 1 to 4.

tf.why: Yes! We go to the hospital when we are sick.
Great! School is a place to learn.

tf.s: We buy things at the hospital.
tf.why: We buy things at the shops.

tf.s: There are some shops is about more than one shop.
tf.why: Well done! Some shops means more than one.

tf.s: There is some houses in my town.
tf.why: More than one house: There are some houses.
Yes! A house is a home.

tf.s: We go to the shops when we are sick.
tf.why: We go to the hospital when we are sick.

tf.s: Is there a café? Yes, there is.
A map shows places in a town.
tf.why: Yes! A map helps us find places.

tf.s: School and hospital are family words.
tf.why: They are places in a town.

boxes.why: We buy things at the shops.
One school: There is a school.
Some shops is more than one.

boxes.q: Is there a café in the picture? (yes)
Present your map: This is my ___.
Write the word for the picture of a doll.
Write the ar word for a picture of a star.

hunt.q: Is there a school? Yes, there…
Have a drink with friends here.
We draw a ___ of our town.

mcq.q: Which is a place in a town?
mcq.why: A hospital is a place in a town.

mcq.q: Which sentence is for more than one?
mcq.why: There are some … is for more than one.

mcq.q: Where do you go when you are sick?
mcq.why: Doctors help us at the hospital.

mcq.q: Describe the picture: one school and five houses.
o: There is a school. There are some houses.
There are a school. There is some houses.
There is some school. There is houses.
mcq.why: One school: There is. Many houses: There are some.

mcq.q: Write a sentence about your town.
o: There is a hospital in my town.
There are a hospital in my town.
mcq.why: There is a hospital in my town.

mcq.q: Your mum needs food. Where does she go?
mcq.why: We buy food at the shops.

mcq.q: Which is a good thing to say about your town?
o: There is a big hospital to help sick people.
There is a star in the shop.
mcq.why: A hospital is a good place that helps people.

mcq.q: Which word is the odd one out?
mcq.why: Uncle is a family word; the others are places.
Shops is more than one: There are some shops.
